reviews.text:
I LOVE LOVE LOVE LOVE THIS!
Firstly, I will definitely repurchase.
Secondly, it leaves my skin so smooth I actually can't believe it.
I have a normal to combinated skin, not prone to acne but I have blackheads and clogged pores, especially after a full face of make up.
It cleans it perfectly! The feeling is refreshed, hydrated and not irritatingly squickish.
reviews.zh:
我超級超級超級超級鍾意！
第一，我一定會再買。
第二，用完皮膚滑到我都唔敢相信。
我係中性至混合皮膚，唔易生暗瘡，但係我有黑頭同堵塞嘅毛孔，尤其係化咗成張面嘅妝之後。
清潔效果好好！感覺清新、水潤，唔會令人覺得討厭或黏膩。

reviews.text:
This has become a HG in my skincare routine. I use it a few times a week, and notice a HUGE difference in my skin texture after using it. 

Make sure to wet your face, and really rub the product in (in little circles) especially around problem areas (I get blackheads under my bottom lip that this stuff takes care of!). After 30-45 seconds, you'll notice balls of gunk that it's peeled off your skin! It's gross but super satisfying. After you rinse, your skin will look & feel like a million bucks...seriously, my skin GLOWS after this...and it helps your other products really soak in.

It's super gentle, and doesn't bother my sensitive skin!
reviews.zh:
呢款已經成為我護膚步驟入面嘅 HG（神級產品）。我每星期用幾次，用完之後皮膚紋理有非常明顯嘅改善。

記得先將面弄濕，然後將產品打圈噉好好揉開，尤其係問題位（我下唇底有黑頭，呢款可以搞掂！）。大約三十至四十五秒之後，你會見到好多好似膠團咁嘅污垢被佢剝走。好核突，但係超級有滿足感。沖走之後，皮膚睇落同摸落都好似值一百萬咁……講真，用完我面會發光……而且會幫其他產品更易滲入皮膚。

佢超温和，唔會刺激我嘅敏感皮膚！

reviews.text: I wanted to find an AHA that would work as a physical exfoliant and this product does just that. READ THE DIRECTIONS ON THE BOTTLE! SHAKE BOTTLE WELL BEFORE EACH USE FOR BEST RESULTS.This exfoliant will remove a thin layer of skin as you rub your face so you don't want to leave it on for any longer than recommended. It leaves my skin bright and smooth without irritation. I use it about three times a month. I will continue to purchase this product.
reviews.zh: 我想搵一款可以做物理去角質嘅 AHA，呢款就正正做到咗。請細閱樽上嘅說明！每次用之前要搖勻，效果先好！呢款去角質劑會隨住你搓面而去除一層薄皮，所以唔好塗超過建議嘅時間。用完令我皮膚明亮、順滑，而且冇刺激。我大約每個月用三次。我會繼續買呢款產品。

reviews.text: I was looking for a good AHA acid that would yield visible results and this product really works. This will peel your skin in the 30 SECONDS you are supposed to use it in. You will feel bits of skin under your fingers. This gel works well, but is still gentle. It didn't leave my face red, irritated, or dry. Be sure to use a good moisturizer and shake the tube well before each use for best results. I was so impressed the first use I bought a second one right away. I have used it once a week for the last 6 weeks, and I am pleased with how bright and soft my skin is after use. This product does what it says it will do.
reviews.zh: 我一直想搵一款有明顯效果嘅 AHA 酸，呢款真係有效。你應該用嗰 30 秒內，就會感覺到手指底下有碎皮。呢款凝膠效果好好，但仍然温和。用完面冇變紅、刺激或者乾燥。記得用好嘅保濕霜，每次用之前搖勻支軟管，效果先好。我第一次用已經好欣賞，即刻再買多一支。我過去六個星期每星期用一次，對用完之後皮膚更亮、更軟感到滿意。呢款產品做到佢所講嘅效果。

reviews.text: I use this 1-2 times a week after cleansing. It brings many of my stubborn and deep blackheads to the surface, where I can gently scrub some of them out, and also brings up pesky but tiny whiteheads where they can also be removed. My skin does not feel irritated when I use it (in fact, it feels firmer after I use this...) and since starting to use it about a month ago, I've noticed a significant decrease in the number of whiteheads I get. This is my first acid exfoliator, and my only regret is that I did not buy something like this earlier (previously I only used physical exfoliators, which were not doing enough on the small-scale to open and clean my pores).
reviews.zh: 我每星期喺潔面後用一至兩次。佢可以將我好多頑固同深層嘅黑頭帶上嚟表面，然後我可以温和咁將部分擦走，仲會帶出煩人但細細粒嘅白頭，亦都可以一併清走。我用嗰陣皮膚冇刺激（其實用完之後感覺仲更緊緻……）。我大約一個月前開始用，發現我長白頭嘅數目顯著減少咗。呢個係我第一款酸類去角質產品，我唯一後悔嘅係冇更早買類似嘅產品（之前我只用物理去角質產品，但喺細微層面上，對打開同清潔毛孔嘅效果唔夠）。

reviews.text: This isn't the typical exfoliator with harsh microbeads, it works in a different way. By just massaging the gel(?) into the skin gently, it works away dead skin cells and gets rid of than you thought you had on the top layer of your skin. The dead skin comes off in little rolls of cells (kind of like when you use an eraser on paper). It also makes your skin super soft after use. I like to use it a few times a week or just whenever my skin feels particularly rough or dry.
reviews.zh: 呢款唔係一般用粗磨微粒嘅去角質產品，佢嘅作用方式唔同。只要温和咁將凝膠（？）按摩入皮膚，就可以去除死皮，帶走比你以為自己有嘅更多死皮。死皮會以一卷卷細細嘅皮屑脫落（有啲似用橡皮擦擦紙嗰種感覺）。用完皮膚都會超級軟滑。我通常每星期用幾次，或者當皮膚特別粗糙或乾燥嗰陣用。

reviews.text: I bought this 2/3 months ago now, so I've tested it a few times, and I'm really satisfied ! The product is amazing, it does the job really well, as it cleans my face deeply and leaves it not only smooth, but also soft. It's not drying at all, which I appreciate, and it smells nice so it's really pleasant to apply. You get to enjoy using it, in fact !
reviews.zh: 我大約兩至三個月前買咗，試過幾次，我真係好滿意！呢款產品好好，效果好好，因為佢可以深層清潔面部，令皮膚唔單止滑，仲好軟。佢完全唔乾燥，呢點我好欣賞，而且味道好聞，塗嗰陣好舒服。事實上，用嘅過程都好享受！

reviews.text: This gel is like, holy grail for me. My skin gets so dry and flaky and makeup always settles on top of it, but this just peels off that grossness until there's a soft new layer of skin underneath. I also have extremely sensitive skin so I can't use most exfoliating products, but this doesn't irritate my skin at all. I can even double-cleanse while using it! Just make sure not to use the peel too often (once a week is fine) and you'll be set. Definitely repurchasing!
reviews.zh: 呢款凝膠對我嚟講好似神級產品咁。我嘅皮膚好乾、會脫皮，化妝成日都會浮喺皮屑上面，但係呢款可以將嗰啲污糟嘢剝走，直到底下出現一層軟嘅新皮膚。我嘅皮膚都非常敏感，所以大部分去角質產品我都用唔到，但係呢款完全唔會刺激我嘅皮膚。我用緊佢嗰陣，甚至可以雙重潔面！只要記得唔好太密咁用去角質（每星期一次就得）就冇問題。一定會再買！

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
